steps.text: CS2 itself needs no setup: Highball picks the graphics mode from the game's row (DXMT on macOS 15 and newer, DXVK below). This recipe's settings are for the legacy CS:GO branch (32-bit, D3D9, csgo.exe): async shader compile off (map-load freeze, issue #21), a 2 GB texture-memory report for the 32-bit process, and a real Radeon device id so Source picks the ATI shadow path.

knownIssues.symptom: Legacy CS:GO freezes at 'Initializing game data' during map load
knownIssues.cause: DXVK async shader compilation wedging the first big compile burst (issue #21)
knownIssues.fix: the dxvkconfig settings in this recipe (async off for csgo.exe)

lastVerified.result: CS2 menu/login/store render under DXVK. Legacy csgo.exe verified reaching in-game with these DXVK settings (2026-08-28 session, delivered then as the built-in default).
